title: FM - FH Volvo Wild Bar Design Aluminium Bullbar #39
description: Series 4 FM-FH Volvo FUPS Bullbar for Wild Bar style suitable for radar attachments. 75mm hi-tensile 6mm wall tube with heavy duty uprights, contoured to compliment the new cab shape. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate, same tensile strength as steel with 2 tow hitches and additional upright for added protection. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Combination LED Indicator, Park, Daylight Running lights mounted in main uprights.
